title: Musings on Markets (Aswath Damodaran's blog)
licence: All rights reserved (the blog carries no licence); stored whole for private search, quoted in short passages with credit as fair use (17 U.S.C. §107)
credit: Aswath Damodaran, Musings on Markets (aswathdamodaran.blogspot.com), quoted briefly with credit
fetch: npm run library:blog -- <scratch> (TypeScript reader, src/library/blog.ts: Blogger JSON feed, 100 posts a call, cached in <scratch>; post dates and published/updated times come from the feed; writes <scratch>/damodaran-blog.documents.json and loads it; add --no-load to stop after the file)

title: Spreadsheets behind Damodaran's blog posts (NYU Stern)
licence: Open site: free use for study with acknowledgement, no commercial resale
credit: Aswath Damodaran, NYU Stern (pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar), spreadsheets linked from Musings on Markets, used with acknowledgement
fetch: npm run library:blog -- <scratch> --no-load (feed cache), then npm run library:sheets -- <scratch> (reads the .xls/.xlsx files his posts link to with SheetJS, saved values only, hidden sheets skipped, at most 12 passages per workbook, dated by the later of post date and file Last-Modified; writes <scratch>/damodaran-spreadsheets.documents.json and loads it; --dry-run N reads N files and writes nothing to the database; his yearly datasets and implied-premium files are excluded)

title: Aswath Damodaran's papers (NYU Stern)
licence: Open site: free use for study with credit, no commercial resale
credit: Aswath Damodaran, NYU Stern (pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar), used with acknowledgement
fetch: python3 -I scripts/library/sources.py damodaran-papers <scratch> <scratch>/damodaran-papers.documents.json ; then optionally node --env-file=.env scripts/library/vision.mjs <scratch>/damodaran-papers.vision-candidates.json and run the first command again

title: New York Fed explainer pages
licence: New York Fed Terms of Use: copy, store and distribute with the source notice
credit: © 2026 Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Content from the New York Fed subject to the Terms of Use at newyorkfed.org.

title: Principles of Finance (OpenStax, 1st edition)
credit: Julie Dahlquist and Rainford Knight, Principles of Finance (OpenStax, 2022), CC BY 4.0; text from the OpenStax GitHub repository at commit 3b7fc65c52, cut into passages
fetch: gh api repos/openstax/osbooks-principles-finance/tarball/3b7fc65c527e > <scratch>/osbooks-principles-finance-3b7fc65c527e.tar.gz && mkdir <scratch>/openstax-1e && tar -xzf <scratch>/osbooks-principles-finance-3b7fc65c527e.tar.gz -C <scratch>/openstax-1e && python3 -I scripts/library/openstax.py <scratch>/openstax-1e/openstax-osbooks-principles-finance-3b7fc65 principles-finance <scratch>/openstax-principles-finance-1e.documents.json https://github.com/openstax/osbooks-principles-finance/blob/3b7fc65c527ef51dbee24689691f19947fb72fb2 (the last commit before OpenStax changed the licence to CC BY-NC-SA, 2025-12-04; its LICENSE file and collection metadata say CC BY 4.0; each passage links to its module's CNXML file at that commit)

title: FOMC statements, minutes and Records of Policy Actions, 1979-2001 (Federal Reserve Board)
licence: US federal publication, public domain unless marked
credit: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, FOMC historical materials (federalreserve.gov): statements, minutes and Records of Policy Actions, each dated by its release
fetch: python3 -I scripts/library/sources.py fomc-historical <scratch> <scratch>/fomc-historical.documents.json (crawls the year pages fomchistorical1979.htm to fomchistorical2001.htm: statements from February 1994, dated by the meeting or their Release Date line; minutes from February 1993, dated by the "Released" date on the year page; Records of Policy Actions to 1992 from PDF, dated by their press-release cover or a week after the next meeting; a PDF goes in only when its text layer passes scripts/library/text-layer.mjs (needs Node 22.18+ for type stripping); scans and every other skip are listed with the reason in <scratch>/fomc-historical.dropped.json; transcripts, Greenbooks, Bluebooks and Beige Books are left out)

title: Amazon.com, Inc., annual and quarterly reports for 1997 to 1999 (SEC filings, 1998-2000)
credit: Amazon.com, Inc., Forms 10-K405, 10-K and 10-Q for fiscal 1997 to 1999, each dated by its filing date (SEC EDGAR)
fetch: python3 -I scripts/library/sources.py sec-amazon-1997-2000 <scratch> <scratch>/sec-amazon-1997-2000.documents.json (the filings in AMAZON_FILINGS of scripts/library/sources.py, the 10-K405 filed 1998-03-30 to the 10-K filed 2000-03-29; each read from its full-submission .txt, first <DOCUMENT> only, with the plain-text reader; the EDGAR submissions API, its 1990s rows through the filings.files pages, confirms each accession, form and filing date; SEC_UA declared, 0.6 s between requests)
